project_name: AegisAI - Generative Chat & Code Telemetry Governance Platform

persona_and_tone.theme_archetype: Swiss High-Contrast + Tactical Engineering (Deep Slate & Obsidian with Signal Indigo and Ember alerts)
persona_and_tone.emotional_tone: Authoritative, mathematically precise, vigilant, transparent, and non-punitive. It champions productivity and skill growth while equipping compliance teams with deep forensic guardrails.

theme_mode.theme_reason: High-density developer and compliance command centers thrive in low-eye-fatigue dark modes with high APCA contrast ratios. Light mode provided for executive briefing.

typography.telemetry_mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Courier New, monospace

surface_strategy.container_treatment: Tactical Minimalism. Deep Obsidian cards (#0F172A) with 1px border (#243248) and 0px to 4px subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg).
surface_strategy.header_nav: Semi-solid high-blur crystal bar (bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800/80). NEVER fully transparent.
surface_strategy.dropdowns_and_popovers: Opaque high-contrast bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 shadow-2xl. Never transparent.

layout_and_bento_grid.spacing_scale: Generous interior padding: p-5 sm:p-6 inside cards. Outer gaps: gap-4 sm:gap-6.
layout_and_bento_grid.corporate_mode_b_grid: 4-column high density telemetry matrix. Top KPI summary row (4 metric blocks: Total AI Spend, Active Engineers, % AI-Generated Code, Safety/PII Incident Rate). Primary telemetry canvas (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8), Lateral compliance anomaly stack (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4).
layout_and_bento_grid.personal_mode_grid: Skill Mode breakdown (Skills, Plan, Ask, Agent mode usage dial), Category Distribution (Learning vs Engineering vs Writing vs Debugging), Model Spend Burn (Codex, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, CLI), and Efficiency Gain Velocity.
layout_and_bento_grid.mobile_rule: Mobile-first: always collapses to grid-cols-1, images capped under 80vh.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Project has React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Recharts + Lucide Icons + Radix UI + Sonner. Work with .js / .jsx files (not .tsx).
2. Implement both Personal View and Corporate Compliance View with a visible role-switcher or tabbed control at top.
3. Provide realistic preset data out-of-the-box (no blank states on initial load) plus a CSV/JSON file uploader that updates the dashboard charts dynamically.
4. Ensure natural-language AI insights are rich and contextual (e.g. 'Engineering Agent usage grew by 42% after Codex CLI v2.4 rollout, saving an estimated 16.4 developer hours this week').

5. Every key card, button, tab, and KPI metric MUST have a clear data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='tab-personal-view', data-testid='kpi-spend-total', data-testid='upload-csv-input').
6. Never leave dropdown or nav backgrounds completely transparent; use solid or frosted backdrop-blur with opaque borders.
7. Include sound feedback and Sonner toasts on actions like importing usage, exporting compliance reports, or adjusting budget threshold alerts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default table borders.
Avoid Inter for main headings; use Outfit or Manrope style sans fonts with tight tracking.
Ensure high contrast in both dark and light modes. Dark mode must tint neutrals with subtle slate (#0F172A / #1E293B).
Do not use forbidden colors: #1B93A4 or #7351B7.
Use Recharts with responsive containers and custom styled tooltips with solid backgrounds.
Make all tabs, filters (7d, 30d, 90d), and role switchers fully reactive.
